name: Zangli Calendar
author: dbzhang

sections.description:
Directory Structure: All files are located in the zangli-calendar directory.
– zangli-calendar/zangli-calendar.php: The main plugin file.
– zangli-calendar/css/style.css: Extracted CSS.
– zangli-calendar/js/zangli.js: The core calendar logic.
– zangli-calendar/js/template-handler.js: The refactored template

How to Use:

  1. Install: Copy the zangli-calendar-plugin folder into your WordPress site’s
    /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate: Go to your WordPress Admin dashboard -> Plugins and
    activate Zangli Calendar.
  3. Display: Insert the following shortcode into any Post, Page, or Widget:
    [zangli_calendar]
